Card Q&A.a: No, if you declared that you will be attacking your opponent, and your opponent decides to block your attack, resulting in a battle between Digimon, the effect does not activate.
Card Q&A.q: I attacked my opponent with a Digimon with this card as one of its digivolution cards, and it was blocked. In this situation, does this card's effect activate?

Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] If you attack one of your opponent's Digimon, this Digimon gets +1000 DP for the turn.
